structure.layout: app shell with fixed left sidebar (logo, main menu, collapsible Recents tree of projects and sessions, footer) and a main area holding a centred hero composer over a dark illustrated scene; a Search sessions modal is open over a dimmed, blurred backdrop

aesthetics.typography: Source Sans Pro throughout — nav items, list rows, input, buttons, headings (Recents 600 weight)
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat scale: 16px body/list/nav dominant, 14px secondary, 12px timestamps and 'New' pill; 18px composer text; weight contrast only 400 vs 600 for section heading

notes: Pure black dark-mode UI. Main area has a dim illustrated night scene (desk lamp, plant, keyboard, window onto a city, coffee mug) in the lower corners and a huge faint outlined brain logo above the composer, with a soft red/blue glow gradient behind the composer. Modal backdrop blurs and darkens the app. Search modal rows are 45px full-width pills (12px radius) with right-aligned muted dates mixing relative ('9 hours ago') and absolute ('Oct 27') formats; the list is long (≈60 sessions) and scrolls inside the dialog with a fade at the bottom. Sidebar recents show compact relative ages (9h, 2d, 1w, 1mo), coloured folder icons for projects (orange, green, blue, teal, purple) with pin icons. Search sessions button reveals Ctrl K keycaps on focus/hover. Footer has mood avatar ('Happy mood') and version string 2.0.0-alpha.1+dev.
